counting_rule.text: Originating-source histogram (units per source). Substrate: the merged WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json work_units array. catalog-slices/*.json is a declared input and is counted as present only when that directory contains a .json file; slice membership otherwise comes from each unit's _source_slice_file and is not itself a source unless cited in inputs. For each work unit, take the set union of document identities extracted from its inputs[] strings (a unit contributes at most once per source). Extraction: (1) normalise backslashes to slashes; (2) strip Windows/POSIX prefixes up to ast-integrate/; (3) rewrite harness-restore absolute prefixes to harness-restore/<basename>; (4) rewrite other /Users/.../.claude/ prefixes to external-claude/<basename>; (5) drop #fragments and :line or :start-end suffixes for SOURCE identity (line ranges are retained separately as spec passage keys); (6) map well-known basenames (CLAIM-REGISTRY.json, _USER-PROMPTS.md, AGENTS.md, …) onto one canonical path so Windows, harness-restore, and repo-relative spellings of the same document do not fork the histogram; (7) numbered estate docs matching ^\d{2}- map to harness-restore/<basename>; (8) named non-file sources: pinned+brief → named:pinned-program-brief; phase-0/phase 0 + digest → named:phase0-ground-digest. Inputs that yield the empty set are prose-only: they are reported as prose_only_unit_count, not dumped into a fake source bucket. Gini: on the vector of positive histogram counts x_(1) ≤ … ≤ x_(n), G = 2*Σ i x_i / (n Σ x_i) − (n+1)/n. Zero-count sources are outside the support. Transitive load-bearing rank of source S: let D(S) be unit ids that cite S. Walk the reverse of the dependencies relation along UNIT-ID edges only (token T → unit U when U.dependencies contains T and T is a work-unit id). Rank(S) = |reach(D(S))| including D(S). Bucket tokens (B07, BKT-*) are not expanded. A shared premise at rank time is an originating source (file/named key). Spec line ranges are an inner grain of _USER-PROMPTS.md, reported on that premise's re-derivation, not as separate histogram keys.

gini.formula: G=2*Σ i x_i/(n Σ x_i)-(n+1)/n on positive histogram counts, i=1..n sorted ascending
gini.interpretation: Near 1 = few sources dominate unit citations; near 0 = even.
